content: CoinGecko API: free public tier allows 5-15 calls/min (no key needed); free Demo tier (free registration) gives 30 calls/min and 10,000 calls/month. BRL is explicitly supported as a vs_currency. Demo tier updates prices every 60 seconds. Key endpoint: /simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum&vs_currencies=brl. Maximum 515 IDs per request. No API key needed for basic access; Demo key stabilizes rate limit. Perfect for a personal app fetching BTC, ETH, and a handful of major coins.
